purpose: Human-readable component vocabulary catalog for WDS screen strain tests. This is not a generator input and does not define tokens.
rules: Use this catalog to decide whether a new screen can be expressed with existing vocabulary before adding components or variants.
Entries describe responsibility and semantic axes, not implementation details or design tokens.
If an entry absorbs a new use case, update its absorbs/used_by/strain_notes instead of creating a near-duplicate entry.
If existing vocabulary cannot express a screen, record the gap in design_system_contract.new_vocabulary_required.
